What does the market regime mean?"市场制度"是什么意思？

The market's internal structure is checked across breadth conditions: what share of stocks are above their 200-day average, how correlated they are, whether leadership is concentrated in a few mega-caps, and whether a rare breadth thrust event fired.市场内部结构通过多项广度条件检验：多少股票站在200日均线以上、相关性高低、领涨是否集中于少数超大盘股，以及是否触发罕见的广度冲击事件。

Field guide — Stage anatomy实战手册 — 阶段解析
What each stage means in plain words. Machine names are in parentheses inside each section.每个阶段的通俗释义。机器内部名称括注于各节内部。
Left for dead — First stirrings无人问津 — 初动迹象►
Machine state: SUPPRESSED / 机器状态：SUPPRESSEDMachine state: SUPPRESSED / 机器状态：SUPPRESSED
RS underperforming for ≥3 months, drawdown ≥25% from 52-week high, valuation often in cheap territory. Sometimes years below the 200dma. Key question: is the compression cyclical or structural?RS连续≥3个月跑输大盘，自52周高点回撤≥25%，估值通常处于低廉区间。有时在200日均线下方数年。关键问题：压缩是周期性的还是结构性的？
Lead indicators:领先指标： revision_positive (cut cycle ending), cheap valuation pctile, insider_cluster, OBV divergence盈利预期转正（削减周期结束）、低廉估值分位、内部人增持、成交量-价格背离
Quiet build — Watch, don't chase静默筑底 — 观察，勿追►
Machine state: QUIET_ACCUMULATION / 机器状态：QUIET_ACCUMULATIONMachine state: QUIET_ACCUMULATION / 机器状态：QUIET_ACCUMULATION
Base forming: 60-day range compression. At least 2 of: revision cycle turning positive (revision_positive), RS slope turning up while long-term RS still negative (rs_turn), accumulation-day count building (accum_evidence), OBV making new highs while price has not (obv_divergence). Highest-ROI watch stage.筑底形成：60日区间压缩。至少2项：预测周期开始转正（revision_positive），RS斜率上升但长期RS仍为负（rs_turn），积累日计数增加（accum_evidence），OBV创新高而价格未创（obv_divergence）。回报率最高的观察阶段。
Lead:领先： rs_turn, revision_positive, obv_divergence相对大盘转强、盈利预期转正、底部买盘积累
Lag:滞后： price confirming (bw_emerging)价格确认（突破酝酿中）
Ignition window — Get ready点火窗口 — 做好准备►
Machine state: CATALYST_WINDOW / 机器状态：CATALYST_WINDOWMachine state: CATALYST_WINDOW / 机器状态：CATALYST_WINDOW
Ignition trigger within 10 sessions: gap ≥+5% on ≥2× 20-day volume (gap_ignition), breakaway watch emerging (bw_emerging), or RS-line making 126-day new high while price has not (rs_line_nh — RS leads price). The Stage-2 foundation is a necessary precondition — ignition without a base almost always reverts.10个交易日内出现点火触发：跳空≥+5%且成交量≥20日均量的2倍（gap_ignition），突破观察新兴（bw_emerging），或RS线创126日新高而价格未创（rs_line_nh — RS领先价格）。阶段2基础是必要前提 — 无基础的点火几乎总是反转。
Strongest leading observable:最强领先可观测指标： rs_line_nh相对强度先于股价创新高
Confirm:确认： a volume gap up, a breakout building, momentum turning up放量跳空上行、突破酝酿中、2日MACD上穿
Breaking away — In motion突破启动 — 行情进行中►
Machine state: BREAKAWAY / 机器状态：BREAKAWAYMachine state: BREAKAWAY / 机器状态：BREAKAWAY
Detector-D onset: liquid ∧ rel-breakaway ∧ 63d-new-high ∧ vol-confirm. Continuation: RS top-decile persistence ≥4 weeks (rs_top_decile_4w). Concentration fingerprint: leader RS-accel > 0 while same-basket peer-median RS < 0 (peer_divergence).突破探测器D启动：流动性 ∧ 相对突破 ∧ 63日新高 ∧ 成交量确认。延续：RS前十分位持续≥4周（rs_top_decile_4w）。集中度指纹：领头者RS加速>0，同伴中位RS<0（peer_divergence）。
Crowded — Protect gains过度拥挤 — 保护利润►
Machine state: CROWDED / 机器状态：CROWDEDMachine state: CROWDED / 机器状态：CROWDED
≥3 of: extension ≥25% vs 50dma (extension_extreme), monthly RSI ≥80 (monthly_rsi_80), parabolic (parabolic), valuation ≥80th pctile 5y (valuation_extreme), analyst buy-share ≥85% (analyst_saturated), basket-correlation ≥0.75 rising from below 0.5 (basket_corr_rising). Late-stage; handoff watch most relevant.≥3项：超伸≥25%（extension_extreme），月RSI≥80（monthly_rsi_80），抛物线（parabolic），估值≥5年80分位（valuation_extreme），分析师买入比例≥85%（analyst_saturated），篮子相关性≥0.75且从低于0.5上升（basket_corr_rising）。后期阶段；接力观察最为重要。
A seventh condition — call-skew richness (call_skew_rich) — is measured nightly but does not count toward the ≥3 while we check whether it carries information; on this options history it has so far behaved like chance. It is shown on the row, never counted.第七项条件——看涨偏斜过高（call_skew_rich）——每晚计算，但在检验其是否具备信息量期间不计入≥3；就目前的期权历史而言，其表现与随机无异。仅在行内显示，不计入统计。
Failed break — Stand aside突破失败 — 观望回避►
Machine state: FAILED / 机器状态：FAILEDMachine state: FAILED / 机器状态：FAILED
Breakaway attempt that reversed — Detector-D "failed" state (bw_failed). Evidence dissipated. Not a permanent label: a name can re-accumulate and re-enter Quiet build (21-session + full de-escalation lockout before the ledger refires).突破尝试后反转 — 突破探测器D"失败"状态（bw_failed）。证据消散。不是永久标签：标的可重新积累并重进静默筑底（台账重新触发前需21个交易日 + 完全去升级锁定）。
Signal classification & base rates信号分类与基础成功率►

A fire badge means the engine logged the event — not that an outcome is expected. Fires are logged and graded automatically after 21 sessions; sample too small for a track record yet.触发标记意味着引擎记录了该事件，而非预期某种结果。触发自动记录，21个交易日后自动评分；样本尚少，未成往绩。

Lead signals (appear before price):领先信号（先于价格出现）： rs_line_nh, revision_positive, obv_divergence, insider_cluster相对强度先于股价创新高、盈利预期转正、底部买盘悄然积累、内部人增持
Confirm signals (coincide with price):确认信号（与价格同步）： a volume gap up, a breakout building, quiet accumulation, momentum turning up放量跳空上行、突破酝酿中、成交量温和吸筹、2日MACD上穿
Lag signals (appear after price):滞后信号（价格后出现）： analyst_saturated, call_skew_rich分析师一致看多、看涨期权被追捧
Value-trap question:价值陷阱问题： Is the multiple compression cyclical or structural? The chip prints the observable; the answer is yours to supply.估值倍数压缩是周期性还是结构性？信号指标呈现可观测指标；答案需要你自己判断。
Stages describe observed evidence, not predictions. Fires are logged and graded automatically after 21 sessions — the forward ledger keeps score.各阶段描述观察到的证据，而非预测。触发自动记录并于21个交易日后自动评分——前瞻台账保存记录。 State tracking began 2026-07-11. Counters accumulate nightly.状态追踪始于7月11日，计数器每晚累积。
